name: bug
description: Reproducible incorrect behavior

name: build
description: Changes that affect the build system or external dependencies (e.g., build: update npm dependencies)

name: chore
description: Miscellaneous tasks that don’t modify src or test files (e.g., chore: update dependencies).

name: ci
description: Changes to CI/CD configuration or scripts (e.g., ci: update GitHub Actions workflow).

name: dependencies
description: Pull requests that update a dependency file

name: docs
description: Documentation-only changes (e.g., docs: update README with installation guide).

name: enhancement
description: A new supported capability or public surface

name: feat
description: A new feature (e.g., feat: add user authentication).

name: fix
description: A bug fix (e.g., fix: resolve login issue).

name: github_actions
description: Pull requests that update GitHub Actions code

name: incident
description: An operational incident affecting users

name: incident-open
description: An incident that is not yet resolved

name: javascript
description: Pull requests that update javascript code

name: perf
description: Code changes that improve performance (e.g., perf: optimize API calls).

name: planning
description: Planning

name: Priority
description: This should be prioritised above things without this label

name: python
description: Pull requests that update python code

name: refactor
description: Code changes that neither fix a bug nor add a feature (e.g., refactor: improve component structure).

name: revert
description: Reverting a previous commit (e.g., revert: revert feat: add user authentication).

name: security
description: Security-related; vulnerabilities go to private advisories

name: slice
description: Mechanically scoped delivery slice

name: style
description: Code style changes (e.g., formatting, missing semi-colons, etc.), not affecting the code’s meaning (

name: support
description: A usage, setup, or documentation question

name: test
description: Adding or modifying tests (e.g., test: add tests for user model).
